shortDescription: Install or remove Arch Linux packages from the AUR

options.name: extra_args
options.description: Additional arguments passed to C(makepkg). Useful for flags such as C(--skippgpcheck) or C(--nocheck).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the package to manage. This value is also used as the local directory name when a Git repository is cloned into the current build user's home directory.

options.name: repository
options.description: Git repository URL containing the package sources and C(PKGBUILD). When omitted, the module queries the AUR RPC API and downloads the package source tarball instead. Repository-based installation is the preferred mode.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the package should be installed or removed.
